items.title: Abdul El-Sayed makes history as first Muslim elected to US Senate
items.summary: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed has won Michigan's Senate race against Republican Mike Rogers, becoming the first Muslim elected to the US Senate. The 42-year-old physician, who represents the progressive wing of the Democratic Party, secured a seat that Republicans had hoped to flip.

items.title: ‘Democrats did a good job’: Trump congratulates Democrats on midterm wins

He said voters supported his actions against Iran but were reluctant to pay more at the pump. Trump also praised Democrats.
